title: ZERO-SHOT ROBUSTIFICATION OF ZERO-SHOT MODELS
measurement_description: The paper measured unwanted/spurious correlation between text toxicity labels and mentions of religious groups in text classification datasets. The goal was to improve the model's robustness and worst-group accuracy for groups defined by religious identity mentions.
findings: The proposed method, ROBOSHOT, improved worst-group accuracy on toxicity classification datasets (CivilComments-WILDS, HateXplain). This indicates it successfully reduced the models' reliance on spurious correlations between toxicity labels and mentions of religious identities (e.g., Christian, Muslim, Jewish, Hindu).
